case.title: Harmony Horizon bridge (ERC20 manager), Ethereum, 23 Jun 2022
case.period: hack: baseline before the incident, then the drain
case.notes: Released through the 2-of-5 multisig 0x715cdda5e9ad30a0ced14940f9997ee611496de6 to attacker 0x0d043128146654c7683fbf30ac98d7b2285ded00. The ~13,100 native ETH taken from the separate ETH manager 0xf9fb1c508ff49f78b60d3a96dea99fa5d7f3a8a6 is not visible here; nor is the AAG token. Releases to attacker_addresses count as theft regardless of size (AAVE ~$67.6k, WETH ~$47.7k fall under theft_min_usd).
case.coverage: Native ETH (~13,100 ETH from the separate ETH manager 0xf9fb1c50...a8a6) and BNB-chain assets are not tracked; covers $76.3M of ~$100M reported.

price_note: Stablecoins and FRAX at $1; WBTC at Chainlink BTC / USD 20,675.18; WETH at Chainlink ETH / USD 1,108.87; AAVE at Chainlink AAVE / USD 68.24; SUSHI at Chainlink SUSHI / USD 1.27; FXS at Chainlink FXS / USD 5.16 (answers at block 15012652). Native ETH is not included except where it passed through WETH (rows with kind weth_wrap / weth_unwrap).
